name: RISE - Transdermal Patch - CBD/THC - 40mg/10mg
description: Our NEW RISE Cannabis Transdermal Patch delivers a precise dose of cannabinoids through the skin for consistent, long-lasting relief. Offering up to 24 hours of steady dosing, it ensures cannabinoids are absorbed directly into the bloodstream every hour through a medical grade transdermal patch. Stick it and forget it, no need to remember to take this product as it last for 24hrs. Time release formula, consistent dosing, discreet, water proof, sweat proof. 97% bioavailability, hypoallergenic, silicone free, latex free, gluten free, vegan. Can be cut into multiple servings.
